head_commit.message:
Fix stale bench and false NO-GO

- api_overlay: the Yahoo API read now replaces Dom's four rosters (dom_rosters.json) when it is newer than the Chrome read, and runs first so a later failure can't skip it. DK IV Nov 4: Harrison Jr. dropped 4:03 AM still showed on the bench in the 4:47 build.
- build_state: Clay/Brenton store their time as 'read'; the health check only looked at 'pulled_pt', so both read as 'no timestamp' and tripped NO-GO. Writers now also set pulled_pt.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Yahoo needle: best lineup on both sides (Dom, Nov 3)

The weekly Yahoo projections read now also reads this week's opponent's whole roster (rows tagged OPP),
and the best-lineup step uses them, so the Yahoo needle counts both teams' best lineups like
Ratcliffe, Koerner and Gotham already do. Opponent rows read live 4:5x PM added to today's files.
Also: Yahoo team pages for another manager carry one extra cell, so the points column is now
aligned from the right when a row's length differs from the header.
Tested on a fresh Week 9 build: DK I 26->42, DK II 18->32, DK III 39->46, DK IV 47->53.
